news.headline: Out (Coach's Decision)
news.detail: Goodson will be a healthy scratch for a second consecutive week, with the Cowboys going with two running backs on the game day roster in Javonte Williams and Emari Demercado. Goodson's next chance to play is Week 4 against the Texans on Sunday, Oct. 4.
